settings.delivery_text: Most Ardea pieces are made to order and ship within 2–4 weeks. Small items are sent by standard courier; larger furniture ships via our delivery partner with room-of-choice placement, and sofas, beds and case goods include two-person white-glove delivery.
settings.default_care_text: Dust regularly with a dry, soft cloth and keep out of direct, prolonged sunlight to avoid uneven fading. Refer to the specific materials used for this piece for any deeper cleaning guidance.
